args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service failed health checks with an error rate of ~18%. v2.3.1 was also unhealthy in staging as v2.3.1-rc. checkout-api was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and review how it was promoted to production when its staging RC was unhealthy.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** I chose v2.3.0 because it's the newest release that was healthy in production. The rollback needed approval, which came through, and all three regions are now on v2.3.0.
- **Check afterward:** The service passes health checks, and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the result. It also lists two follow-ups:
  - Find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
  - Find out why v2.3.1 was released to production even though its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) was already unhealthy in staging.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
